title: Import routine method blanks
purpose: Copy current routine method-blank QC measurements into one open MDL study without losing non-detects or source context.
summary: Copy routine method-blank QC measurements for this test into the MDL study. Non-detects and their source context are kept.

tasks.title: Import routine blanks
steps: Set the From and To analysis dates.

tasks.title: Use the other source basis
steps: Choose it and explain the full-procedure evidence. The reason is kept with every copied blank.

good_to_know: Blanks already imported into this study are skipped.
Non-detects stay non-detects. Nothing is changed to zero.
Where the source had no preparation time, the analysis time is used and marked assumed.
A later QC correction does not change blanks already copied.

sections.title: Access and fields
paragraphs: Active internal staff with a laboratory role can read MDL records. Analysts enter observations, import routine blanks and calculate. Analysts or reviewers can exclude observations and close studies; the page buttons for these two actions are shown to analysts. Only an independent reviewer can decide a calculation. Admin includes operational roles but never bypasses independence; client accounts and superuser status alone do not grant access.
Analyst access and an open study are required. The selected source must have undergone all required processing steps; the application cannot establish this from a batch label.

items.label: From / To
items.description: Required inclusive local analysis dates, initially the date 24 calendar months before today through today. From cannot follow To. These are import selection dates, not a promise that all imported observations will fall inside a later calculation window.

items.label: Routine blank source basis
items.description: Required Preparation-batch blanks or Analytical / combined full-procedure blanks. Default is preparation when the test currently has an active independent-preparation requirement, otherwise analytical. One basis is copied per submission.

items.label: Full-procedure evidence for alternative basis
items.description: Optional for the current default basis; required when choosing the other basis. Explain actual full-method processing including required preparation. The reason is retained with every copied blank.

sections.title: Selection and provenance
paragraphs: Only current method-blank QC measurements for the exact test definition, selected batch kind and inclusive analysis dates qualify. Previously imported measurement IDs in this study are skipped, including excluded observations; an updated current measurement has a new identity. The latest reject-data disposition for this analyte or a batch-wide finding excludes a blank when either its source or actual analytical batch is rejected. Rejections for another analyte do not exclude this test’s blanks. No QC pass-only filter is applied.

Copies original observed text, numerical/non-detect kind, value, preparation/analysis times, source batch and QC-sample labels, measurement link and selected basis/evidence. The importer becomes this observation’s entered-by contributor. If source preparation time is absent or later than its analysis, analysis time is substituted and marked assumed; it does not count toward actual preparation-date spread. Source instrument is not copied into the observation’s instrument field.

items.label: Import blanks
items.description: Copies eligible observations and writes an attributed import audit event atomically, then returns to the study with imported count and rejected-batch skip count. A zero-record import does not fabricate data.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the study without copying anything.

sections.title: Historical meaning
paragraphs: Imported observations retain a snapshot of their source context; later QC correction does not rewrite them or existing calculation snapshots. Re-import skips the old source measurement ID. Review the resulting records and readiness before calculating.
